beats.say: Morgan Wallen brought out Ella Langley for their eighth tour appearance together.
Their eighth joint appearance arrived in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, on 18 April 2026.
Langley first joined Wallen on stage in June 2025, then in Nashville on 3 April.
On 24 April 2026, the duo officially released I Can't Love You Anymore.
The release marks their very first collaboration.
